experiment: Skipped and gated. No experiment was active to evaluate, and a pause gate (noNewExperimentsUntil 2026-07-28) was set in .experiments.json because today's Opus 4.8 → Opus 5 migration (commit af5e869b) rewrote the selector model — the stage that drives category mix, multi-source rate and region spread. weakestArea: Region spread is the softest metric: 5 regions vs 6 on 2026-07-22, with Oceania dropping to zero and Africa thin at 5 of 53. Still above the target of 4, and OC is structurally low-volume in global hard news, but the AM+EU pair now carries 30 of 53 stories (57%). Freshness again reports over only 4 dated articles, so the median-0 reading is directional rather than a corpus measure.
watching: First full day on Opus 5 for the selector — throughput held at 53 articles across 5 clean cycles and avg cycle duration fell to 900s from 1016s, but category mix tilted to politics (20 of 53, 38%) versus 14 on 2026-07-22; watch whether that persists or was news-driven.

Multi-source count reached 11, the highest in recent audits, and sits well clear of the 4/day target — if it holds through the model baseline it would be the first movement on the sourcing cluster since the selector-floor lever was declared tapped out in May.
Crypto concentration: CoinDesk is joint top source at 5 stories two days running, all economy/tech — worth confirming it is not crowding out broader economy coverage.
coverageGaps: Oceania had no coverage at all today, down from 1 story on 2026-07-22.
Latin America surfaces only through AM-tagged wire copy; no regional Latin American outlet appeared in the 47-source pool.
Science volume (10) rests on a narrow pool — Nature, Phys.org, Carbon Brief and New Scientist supply most of it.
context: All four goal areas — freshness, diversity, multi-source and educational value — are met with margin, so no parameter is underperforming enough to warrant a change even absent the gate. Standing constraint from the May experiments: the selector multi-source floor lever is exhausted (feed supplies ~9 multi-source stories/cycle, capping the published rate near 22%), so future sourcing gains must come from upstream feed composition. TOP_EVENTS_TO_FETCH stays at 8 regardless — each unit is one NewsAPI token per cycle and spend is capped.
